target_customer: AI labs and ML teams that train and evaluate vision models
problem: Frontier models lack high quality visual training data and evals; the company builds supervised datasets, environments and benchmarks for visual intelligence.
business_model: Custom and supervised datasets and eval services sold to ML teams
product_category: Vision data and evals for AI

founders.name: Mehul Chadda
founders.background_notes: Background in metrology per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Building high fidelity vision datasets and verifiers is labor and tooling intensive; the earlier Chunkr product used a Rust pipeline reaching about 4 pages per second on one RTX 4090 (company claim).

defensibility.rationale: Datasets are bespoke services that larger labeling vendors can offer, and the open source Chunkr was easy to compare against rivals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Chunkr is reported to be joining Extend with its hosted API shutting down November 15, 2026; the YC page lists the company as Acquired without naming a buyer.

market_need_then: Document parsing for RAG was in demand in 2024 (Chunkr launch reached about 400K impressions per the founders), and later demand for vision training data grew with frontier model labs.

identity.voice_and_tone: Technical positioning as a vision data foundry

rebrands.why: Not stated in sources; the company pivoted from document parsing to vision data

branding.community_and_virality: Chunkr open source launch reported about 400K impressions by the founders

brand_strength.rationale: Little press about the brand; the name refers to floating point arithmetic and carries no clear link to visual data, and there was a product rename from Chunkr.

pivots.from: Lumina, AI search engine for scientific literature
pivots.to: Chunkr, open source document parsing for RAG
pivots.why: Described in the Chunkr launch post; reason not detailed
Not stated; website now references Chunkr as earlier work

outcome_analysis: floatingpoint grew out of Lumina and Chunkr and later positioned as a vision data foundry; YC marks it Acquired without naming a buyer. A directory reports that Chunkr is joining Extend and that the hosted API shuts down on November 15, 2026. Whether the whole company or only the Chunkr product was acquired is unclear, and no funding is public, so the factor lists are empty.
notes: Exit: YC status is Acquired but no acquirer is named; the Extend link is a single directory listing about the Chunkr product and is unverified; floatingpoint.ai still operates and shows no acquisition notice. YC page says founded 2025 while the batch is Winter 2024. The website names Y Combinator, Jack Altman, Terrence Rohan and Evan Conrad as backers without amounts; these are not recorded as rounds. Competitor search returned only 2026 vendor comparison pages (Labelbox, Encord, Reducto, Docling), so no dated competitor list is recorded.
